parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required when authenticating with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK and SK) or Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: localId
parameters.description: The sequential ID of the merge request within the repository.
